# Vendor Change Evidence

> Free, no-signup, no-upload tool that compares two dated vendor policy snapshots (privacy, terms, subprocessors, security) in your browser and reports what changed. Runs entirely client-side.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
